issues.t: sqs: queue-URL addressing diverges from AWS — CreateQueue publishes an unserved real-AWS host, and a path-less queue URL is refused QueueDoesNotExist instead of InvalidAddress
7 net-new causes: redrive/move-task identity and receive counts, FIFO batch and attribute refusal codes, tag-condition authorization, and the Policy limit error

5 net-new causes: the Query protocol does not answer XML, the raw-JSON refusal is wrong, anonymous SendMessage hits an unregistered service, CreateQueue compares stale attributes and the AWSTraceHeader is refused

sqs: the awsQueryCompatible x-amzn-query-error response header is emitted only when the request opts in with x-amzn-query-mode, so a client that does not send the opt-in gets no legacy Query error code
sqs: SetQueueAttributes refuses a FIFO-only attribute name as InvalidAttributeValue instead of InvalidAttributeName

sqs: SetQueueAttributes naming FifoQueue on a standard queue is refused InvalidAttributeValue ("Modifying queue type is not supported") instead of AWS's InvalidAttributeName "Unknown Attribute FifoQueue."
sqs: the nodejs22.x Lambda runtime resolves no bundled AWS SDK for JavaScript v3, so a JS v3 consumer cannot observe SQS's awsQueryCompatible error carriers
SQS SetQueueAttributes: the byQueue-without-sourceQueueArns RedriveAllowPolicy refusal carries an emulator-authored Reason sentence
SQS GetQueueAttributes refuses an existing queue with 400 instead of returning its QueueArn
SQS SetQueueAttributes queue-type immutability refusal uses InvalidAttributeName instead of InvalidAttributeValue
SQS queue URLs are emitted with the emulator listener host instead of the AWS endpoint form (2 causes)
sqs: 5 net-new causes — four refusal messages are emulator-authored, and RedriveAllowPolicy / StartMessageMoveTask validation is missing entirely
SQS validation refusals carry the wrong error class, status or Reason wording
SQS queue-attribute state and response payloads diverge from AWS: unenforced FifoQueue attribute, missing default attributes, wrong Policy version, empty-map envelope and non-AWS opaque handles
SQS awsQueryCompatible error envelope is not emitted: no x-amzn-query-error header and unqualified __type on error responses
SQS refuses a queue-type-mismatched RedrivePolicy with the wrong Reason text (1 cause)
A dead-letter move never happens on an SQS queue wired with maxReceiveCount, so the DLQ copy's retention clock (carried over on standard, reset on FIFO) is unobservable
sqs: SendMessageBatch still answers a bare HTTP 413 for an over-aggregate-size batch instead of AWS.SimpleQueueService.BatchRequestTooLong
SQS SendMessage: an oversized (2 MB) MessageBody is refused with InvalidParameterValue instead of a transport-level HTTP 413

sqs: 4 net-new behavioral root causes — RedriveAllowPolicy is enforced at neither write time nor redrive time, and StartMessageMoveTask neither validates a self-referential destination nor actually moves anything
SQS cross-region RedrivePolicy is refused with the wrong Reason text: the dead-letter-target region rule is reported with AWS's redrive-allow-policy wording (1 cause)
A COMPLETED SQS message move task is unreachable: maxReceiveCount is never counted so the DLQ stays empty, and ListMessageMoveTasks' moved/to-move counters are never exercised
SQS StartMessageMoveTask never completes a DLQ drain: no COMPLETED task with ApproximateNumberOfMessagesMoved/ToMove, and the automatic redrive that feeds it never happens (1 cause)
sqs: the ListQueues forged/expired NextToken refusal message is the emulator's own wording instead of AWS's 'Invalid or expired next token.'
sqs: a queue resource policy granting a non-owner principal is still not honored — the grantee stays AccessDenied, so both queue-policy grant checks hang to the 60 s cap

sqs: 10 net-new behavioral root causes — BatchRequestTooLong served as a bare 413, receipt-handle lifetime and stale-handle refusals, no automatic DLQ redrive, queue-policy grants/validation ignored, two refusal-message

sqs: 3 net-new SSE root causes — the both-SSE-modes refusal message is emulator-authored, an explicit Deny in a CMK key policy is never applied to the account's own credential, and a CFN-created KMS key is unresolvable s

sqs: 4 net-new behavioral root causes — SendMessage refuses MessageSystemAttributes (AWSTraceHeader) outright, and three refusal messages are not AWS's text (CreateQueue FIFO cross-attribute, ReceiveRequestAttemptId, Sta
sqs: 5 net-new behavioral root causes — SendMessageBatch per-entry code for an empty body, CreateQueue Policy/tags conflict detection, and three emulator-authored refusal-message templates

sqs: 7 net-new batch/message-move root causes — SendMessageBatch accepts empty-bodied entries (standard and FIFO), applies MaximumMessageSize to the batch total, re-words per-entry messages; DeleteMessageBatch is not ide

sqs: DeleteMessageBatch's ReceiptHandleIsInvalid entry message is re-worded, and a request body far over the 262144-byte limit is answered ValidationException instead of a transport-level HTTP 413 (2 causes)

SQS batch-send, visibility-change and AddPermission refusal taxonomy is absent: all three answer NotImplemented instead of the modeled AWS.SimpleQueueService.* / ReceiptHandleIsInvalid / InvalidParameterValue codes (3 ca
SQS refusal taxonomy: input-validation refusals answer 'ValidationException', an error SQS does not model, instead of InvalidParameterValue / MissingParameter / InvalidAttributeValue (10 causes)
SQS receipt handles are opaque per-receive UUIDs with no message or queue binding: a repeat delete is refused, and a foreign-queue handle is indistinguishable from a malformed one (5 causes)
SQS queue resource policies are stored but never enforced: every send, receive, delete and DeleteQueue is authorized regardless of the Policy attribute (7 causes)

SQS queue lifecycle gaps: CreateQueue idempotency is inverted (differing Policy conflicts, differing tags does not), QueueDeletedRecently is never raised, ListQueues pagination and tag-key rules are unvalidated, and an e
Implement sqs PurgeQueue: unimplemented scaffold stub
SQS never redrives to a dead-letter queue: maxReceiveCount is stored but not counted, RedrivePolicy/RedriveAllowPolicy are not validated, and RedrivePolicy reads back malformed (4 causes)
SQS message attributes are neither validated nor selected per AWS rules, and MessageSystemAttributes (AWSTraceHeader) is refused outright by the emulator (5 causes)
Implement sqs ListDeadLetterSourceQueues: unimplemented scaffold stub
SQS has no time-driven queue semantics: retention never expires a message, and visibility/delay changes against live messages never converge (4 causes, all hitting the 60 s cap)
SQS has no per-region identity: QueueArn hardcodes one region, a queue URL from another region is served, and cross-region DLQ / move-task wiring is accepted (5 causes)
SQS FIFO receive-side idempotency is absent: ReceiveRequestAttemptId never replays a batch, the deduplication window never elapses, and FifoThroughputLimit is not validated (3 causes)
SQS encryption is inert: a new queue reports no SSE at all, KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds is absent, an invalid CMK is accepted, and no KMS grant gates produce or consume (6 causes)

Implement sqs ChangeMessageVisibility: unimplemented scaffold stub
Implement sqs CancelMessageMoveTask: unimplemented scaffold stub
